title: Topic 18
japanese_text: 大学での研究を社会に活かす「大学発<u>ベンチャー</u>」が注目を集めている。技術革新のスピードが速いIT<u>系</u>、世界的にも注目度が高いバイオ系・ヘルスケア系などの<u>業種</u>に多い。大学と産業界の<u>提携</u>は今後ますます強くなっていくだろう。
english_translation: University-launched ventures, which make use of university research for society, have been attracting attention. Many are in IT-related industries, where the pace of technological innovation is rapid, in biotechnology and healthcare, which are attracting worldwide attention, and in similar industries. Partnerships between universities and industry are expected to grow even stronger in the future.
